newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Merrill Lynch in deal with LG Securities.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch in deal with LG Securities.

text.p: Merrill Lynch Asset Management has granted South Korea's LG Securities Co Ltd the exclusive right to distribute Merrill Lynch Asset offshore mutual funds to local investors, a statement said on Tuesday.

The partnering of Merrill Lynch Asset, a unit of Merrill Lynch & Co, and LG gives South Korean clients access to more than 34 international money market, equity and bond portfolios, the statement from LG Securities said.
LG Securities, a unit of LG Group, said the move followed government deregulation in December that for the first time allowed securities firms to distribute foreign asset management products.
